questions.question: The MacTutor university biography dates the beginning of Dudeney’s correspondence with Sam Loyd to 1893 and describes an exchange of puzzles, not joint authorship of most of Dudeney’s early work.

localizations.source: The MacTutor university biography dates the beginning of Dudeney’s correspondence with Sam Loyd to 1893 and describes an exchange of puzzles, not joint authorship of most of Dudeney’s early work.
localizations.ru: Университетская биография MacTutor датирует начало переписки Дьюдени с Сэмом Лойдом 1893 годом и описывает обмен задачами, а не совместное авторство большинства ранних головоломок.

questions.resolution: The year and nature of the collaboration were corrected from the MacTutor biography.
